This planning and development related data-set contains locations and tabular details related to Development Permit System applications.
Please refer to the Planning and Development webpage for more information, notices and contact information.

Development Application data-sets have been retired and are now broken down into:
  • Pre-Consultation Applications
  • OPA ZBA Subdivision Applications
  • Draft Plan of Condominium Applications
  • Development Permit System
  • Consent to Sever Applications
  • Minor Variance Applications
  • Site Plan Approval Applications
  • Sustainable Neighbourhood Action Plan areas (SNAP)
  • GTAA Airport Zoning Regulation area
  • GTAA Airport Operating Area
Updated Daily.
